title: Q-STD-sbom-slsa: Attach an SPDX SBOM and SLSA build provenance to every deploy
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** OPEN-STANDARDS-1 register entry `sbom-slsa` is planned or partial in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation openstd --probe sbom-slsa
**Status:** open

In deploy-ultrastable.yml fetch the SPDX 2.3 SBOM from the GitHub dependency graph and attest each built worker bundle with actions/attest-build-provenance (built-in token, no person-minted credential); record both on the ops/deploys.jsonl row.

**Prediction:** deploys_with_sbom_share >= 1 within 336 h

**Out of scope:** Signing with a key a person holds.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation openstd --probe sbom-slsa` exits 0.
